name: Como Metropolitan London
positioning: COMO Metropolitan London: a light-filled contemporary hotel on Old Park Lane in Mayfair, opposite Hyde Park, with a COMO Shambhala spa and Nobu upstairs
best_for: Travelers who want Hyde Park across the road and Mayfair, Knightsbridge and Bond Street on foot
Wellness-minded guests who want yoga in the room and a spa with steam rooms in the building
Families or longer stays that need a private apartment nearby

facts.text: The hotel is on Old Park Lane in Mayfair, opposite Hyde Park.
Bond Street, Belgravia, Knightsbridge and Piccadilly are within walking distance of the hotel.
Rooms and suites overlook Hyde Park or the Mayfair skyline.
Light floods the rooms through expansive windows, with an uncluttered design and intuitive technology.
Interiors feature light woods and sun-soaked whites with accents of vibrant yellow.
The rooms feature fretwork inspired by Hyde Park, walnut and sycamore, and yellow chenille.
The lobby window has a flickering fire-and-water feature.
Selected Park Suites have a private balcony.
The COMO Shambhala spa has two couple's treatment rooms.
Guests have complimentary access to the COMO Shambhala steam room and fitness centre during their stay.
The spa offers private yoga sessions led by expert instructors.
Labombe by Trivet is a wine-forward restaurant and bar from the team behind Trivet.

highlights.text: The Metropolitan opened on Park Lane in 1997.
The COMO Suite has sweeping views across Hyde Park.
Every room comes with its own yoga mat and access to guided videos.
The spa has separate male and female steam rooms.
Hotel guests get priority bookings at the Japanese-Peruvian restaurant Nobu, on the hotel's first floor.

considerations.text: Every room except the Deluxe City Rooms has a bath, so book above that category if a bathtub matters.
The Brick Street and Hertford Street Residences, the private apartments for longer stays or families, are nearby rather than in the main hotel.
WhataHotel notes the minimalist design may feel understated for some guests.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: COMO Metropolitan London review
